* Add double-tap seeking with a 1–60 second slider, an off position and a reset control. ([#41](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/41))
* Restore channel following and show uploaded channel videos in an app-native listing. ([#42](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/42), [#47](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/47))
* Show creator following, series, and parent/child works for Shorts, including the Shorts details panel. ([#43](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/43))
* Replace the obsolete comment submission path that crashed on missing metadata. ([#44](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/44))
* Use the current Watch Later registration endpoint. ([#45](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/45))
* Keep vertical videos portrait in fullscreen and allow opening the normal player from Shorts details with the current playback position. ([#46](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/46))
* Open video actions as a popup on long press; add confirmed exact-match uploader blocking and device-local playlists.
* Manage local playlist folders, move videos, and delete individual or multiple videos.
* Remove empty cache folders containing only the media scanner marker after the cached files are deleted.
* Keep the settings screen and scroll position when changing the app language; clarify content-filter summaries.
* Simplify the Shorts overlay to creator, title, translucent like/follow icons and an oval comment entry. Toggle it on video taps and preserve the existing bottom controls.
* Improve offline interaction variety and retain consistent drawing and collision behavior.
* Reuse native video-list rows, sorting and bottom selection controls in device playlists.
* Add folder creation to the account mylist registration dialog.
* Unify dialog surfaces and theme colors, including text fields and slider reset controls.
